topic: What time does the Science Museum in London close, and is entry free?

text: Ok so sunday? Thinking science museum, 10am?
Is it free to get in? And what time does it close, don't want to turn up and find we only get an hour 😅
@claude is entry to the science museum in london free and what time does it close

Yes, general entry is free, though it asks you to book a free timed ticket in advance. It's open daily 10am to 6pm, with last entry at 5:15pm. A 10am start gives you about 8 hours. Some exhibitions and cinema shows are charged. One page I checked was last updated in December 2025, so check the museum's website before Sunday.

https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/venues/science-museum/
